KARL MAYER opens a new era in textile innovation 🚀. KARL MAYER officially inaugurated its new TEXTILE INNOVATION CENTER (TIC) in Obertshausen, Germany, bringing together warp knitting, technical textiles and warp preparation technologies under one roof. The 5,000 m² innovation hub is designed to accelerate textile development from idea to industrialization, offering advanced machinery, collaborative R&D opportunities and hands-on prototyping capabilities. Industry leaders including Karl Josef Mayer, Lutz Wolf and experts from New Balance Athletics highlighted the importance of connected textile innovation and future-oriented textile solutions during the event.
